color.week.history.background.element: screen background behind week sections (light mode)

color.week.history.header.title.method: median of darkest 30% of glyph pixels (L<100)

color.week.history.header.range.element: date range after the header, e.g. "Jul 3 - 9"
color.week.history.header.range.method: median of darkest 30% of glyph pixels (L<215)

color.week.history.tile.add.fill.element: "+" add tile fill at the end of the current week strip
color.week.history.tile.add.fill.method: median of 7x7 box, two samples agree

color.week.history.tile.empty.fill.element: empty-day placeholder tile fill (day with no photo)
color.week.history.tile.empty.fill.notes: 2024 user screenshot reads #EDEDED (recompressed); 2023 press and the 2026 add tile both read #F1F1F1.

color.week.history.tile.empty.text.element: empty-day tile text (month / day number / weekday)
color.week.history.tile.empty.text.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/tc-2023-07-retro-2b.jpg tile x378-564 y402-650 (lines y456-479, 502-546, 571-593); references/auto/retro/press/jeddacp-2024-05-home-profile-journals.png tile x585-666 y338-443
color.week.history.tile.empty.text.method: median of darkest 10% glyph pixels: 221/216/218 (2023), 215-218 (2024); rounded mid value

color.week.history.more.glyph.element: "•••" more button at right of week header

dimension.week.history.tile.width.element: photo / add / empty day tile width
dimension.week.history.tile.width.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)
dimension.week.history.tile.width.notes: Ratio 21.5% of screen width; play-02 21.6%, 2023 press 21.7%.

dimension.week.history.tile.height.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

dimension.week.history.tile.gap.element: white gap between adjacent tiles in a strip
dimension.week.history.tile.gap.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png y=1475 x420-423 white + ~50% partial px at 419 and 424 (~5 px)
dimension.week.history.tile.gap.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

radius.week.history.strip.element: outer corners of the day strip only (first tile left corners, last tile right corners); inner tile corners square
radius.week.history.strip.method: least-squares circle fit to per-row edge inset: 34.4/34.6/35.0 px, then px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)
radius.week.history.strip.precision: ±1 pt; circular vs continuous corner not distinguishable
radius.week.history.strip.notes: references/auto/retro/play/retro-play-02.png: 34.9 px of 966 px screen, same ratio. TechCrunch 2024-07-11: "rounded corners on the outside".

radius.week.history.tile.inner.element: corners of tiles where they meet a neighbour

dimension.week.history.inset.leading.element: leading inset of week header text and day strip
dimension.week.history.inset.leading.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png strip x=218, header ink x=221, screen x=171
dimension.week.history.inset.leading.notes: references/auto/retro/play/retro-play-02.png: 49/966 = 5.07% of width vs 5.0% on iOS. Strip has no trailing inset: it scrolls horizontally and clips at the screen edge.

dimension.week.history.header.toStrip.element: header text baseline to top of day strip
dimension.week.history.header.toStrip.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

dimension.week.history.section.gap.element: bottom of one week strip to cap top of next week header
dimension.week.history.section.gap.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)
dimension.week.history.section.gap.notes: Android render is tighter (strip-to-strip 119 px of 966 vs 139 px of 939 on iOS).

dimension.week.history.section.pitch.element: strip top to next strip top (one week section)

dimension.week.history.header.rangeGap.element: ink gap between "Week N" and the date range
dimension.week.history.header.rangeGap.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)
dimension.week.history.header.rangeGap.notes: Likely a space character at 15 pt plus side bearings.

fontSize.week.history.header.element: "Week N" header and its date range
fontSize.week.history.header.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png "W" cap y1289-1313 (24-25 px), x-height ~18 px; range "J" y1288-1314
fontSize.week.history.header.method: cap 10.2 pt / SF Pro cap-height 0.705 = 14.5; x-height 7.5 pt / 0.517 = 14.6

fontWeight.week.history.header.title.method: visual stem comparison against regular-weight range text

dimension.week.history.tile.weekday.base.element: weekday label baseline above tile bottom; label horizontally centred
dimension.week.history.tile.weekday.base.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png baseline y1576, tile bottom y1608; "Tue" centre x524.5 = tile centre
dimension.week.history.tile.weekday.base.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

icon.week.history.add.element: "+" in add tile (matches a plain plus glyph, 20 pt, ~2.9 pt stroke, black)
icon.week.history.add.notes: Reference glyph measured 20 pt square with 2.9 pt bars; centred in tile.

dimension.week.history.tile.addGlyph.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

icon.week.history.more.element: "•••" at right of each week header (3 dots 4.2 pt, pitch 7.1 pt)

dimension.week.history.more.trailing.element: "•••" right ink edge to screen edge; vertically centred on header text
dimension.week.history.more.trailing.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-02.png x1056 -> 1109; dots centre y1302 = header centre y1301
dimension.week.history.more.trailing.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

layout.week.history.order.value: vertical list, newest week first; within a week, one tile per photo in chronological order Mon->Sun (several photos on one day = several tiles with the same weekday label); strip scrolls horizontally
layout.week.history.order.element: week section list and day strip

layout.week.history.weekStart.value: ISO-8601 weeks, Monday start; header number = ISO week number

layout.week.history.currentWeek.value: current week strip ends with the "+" add tile (2026; first in 2023) followed by empty-day placeholder tiles; a current week with no photos shows "Week N" without a date range and empty tiles carrying month / day number / weekday

font.week.history.title.element: display title "Week 27" (home) / week title; Retro uses a heavy condensed serif
font.week.history.title.method: company site CSS names the face; in-app glyphs visually consistent
font.week.history.title.notes: Roslindale (David Jonathan Ross, djr.com) is commercial; "Roslindale Retro v0.2" appears to be a custom cut. Proprietary -> platform font. Do not ship the font file.

dimension.week.history.title.capHeight.element: cap height of the display title ("Week 27"; Rewind date "July 5, 2021")
dimension.week.history.title.capHeight.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt); raw screenshots px/3
dimension.week.history.title.capHeight.notes: x-height 21.8 pt (x/cap 0.72) in the reference face.

fontSize.week.history.title.element: display title set in the platform font so its cap height matches the reference (30.1 pt)
fontSize.week.history.title.method: 30.1 pt cap / SF Pro cap-height ratio 0.705 = 42.7
fontSize.week.history.title.notes: Derived by cap-height match because the reference face is proprietary; weight in reference is heavy/black.

dimension.week.history.title.leading.element: left ink inset of the serif display title
dimension.week.history.title.leading.evidence: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-01.png x207 (15.1 pt); references/auto/retro/press/tc-2025-12-rewind-device-a.png x49 (16.3 pt); references/auto/retro/press/tc-2025-12-rewind-device-b.jpg x47 (15.7 pt)

dimension.week.history.title.toStrip.element: home title baseline to top of current-week strip
dimension.week.history.title.toStrip.method: px / 2.389 (939-px screen = 393 pt; confirmed by 320-px home indicator = 134 pt)

fontSize.week.history.onThisWeek.subtitl.element: "On this week" subtitle under the date in the Rewind entry
fontSize.week.history.onThisWeek.subtitl.notes: White at reduced opacity over photo; opacity not measurable.

dimension.week.history.rewind.dial.element: Rewind ("On this week") scrub dial outer diameter; ~45 radial ticks alternating long 18 pt / short 11 pt; play/pause glyph centred
dimension.week.history.rewind.dial.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/tc-2025-12-rewind-device-b.jpg centre (630,2217.5), outer tick radius p50 225 px; inner radius p50 171 / p90 193 px
dimension.week.history.rewind.dial.method: radial brightness profile over 720 angles, raw @3x px/3
dimension.week.history.rewind.dial.notes: references/auto/retro/store/retro-store-05.png marketing panel gives ~133 pt on a 393-pt mockup.

dimension.week.history.rewind.sideButton.element: translucent circular share (left) and random/dice (right) buttons flanking the dial
dimension.week.history.rewind.sideButton.evidence: references/auto/retro/press/tc-2025-12-rewind-device-b.jpg share x108-300, dice x960-1152 at y~2217

dimension.onthisday.share.tab.underline.element: underline under selected share tab ("SQUARE" | "FULL"); tab label cap 11.5 pt, uppercase

layout.onthisday.dayBoundary.element: when the "on this day" set rolls over to the next day

layout.onthisday.notification.time.evidence: https://help.timehop.com/article/751-how-to-manage-timehop-notifications ("a gentle reminder every morning at 8 am")
layout.onthisday.notification.time.notes: Timehop is the reference for onthisday only; the merge decides whether this feeds notifications.push. Timehop also sends an afternoon push if unopened and a "finish your day" nudge: DO NOT COPY (nagging, tenet 5).
